explanation: I found no Mathlib result saying that an L² function on (a,b) orthogonal to all the sines sin(kπ(x-a)/(b-a)) is zero a.e. I searched Mathlib for sine-series, completeness and uniqueness statements, and for fourierCoeff or fourierCoeffOn lemmas that give a.e. vanishing. The Fourier files only give span_fourier_closure_eq_top, span_fourierLp_closure_eq_top and the Hilbert basis fourierBasis. Deriving the sine statement from those would need the odd extension and several auxiliary facts, which is well beyond two lines.
